name: paperboy-monorepo
description: Paperboy: the open-source growth engine. Each package installs on its own (no workspace hoisting).

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix packages/engine && npm ci --prefix packages/cli && npm ci --prefix packages/db
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/engine && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/cli
scripts.test: npm test --prefix packages/engine && npm test --prefix packages/cli && npm test --prefix packages/db && npm run test:scripts
